entry_points: dispatchPlan with wave and full-plan semantics
tenant_boundaries: plan lookup uses caller org or NULL legacy
assignment preflight/transaction/update now inherit selected plan org
task preflight allows same-org or explicit legacy NULL

findings.evidence: Assignment preflight, transactional partition and status update selected by planId/assignmentId without inheriting selected plan tenant.
findings.impact: Duplicate assignment IDs across orgs (allowed by composite unique key) could be read or updated across tenant boundaries during dispatch.
findings.fix: Derive assignmentOrgCond from selected plan org and apply it to preflight, transactional partition and update predicates.

findings.evidence: Assignment dispatch update did not guard against concurrent status/version changes between transaction reads and update.
findings.impact: A concurrent assignment mutation could be overwritten within the dispatch transaction before plan-level CAS rejected the second dispatch flow.
findings.fix: Added org + status + version CAS to assignment update, explicit ASSIGNMENT_CONCURRENT_UPDATE failure, wave version regression, and serialized fake-transaction harness.
